responsibility: This file defines the canonical token-kind enumeration for the mc lexer and parser. It contributes the full mcReserved_toktype set covering punctuation, keywords, literals, identifiers, directives, attributes, and comment tokens used uniformly by mcflex, mcLexBuf, and parser passes mcp1 through mcp5, with no additional logic beyond module initialization hooks.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file contributes the compiled definition of the mcReserved_toktype enumeration and module init/fini stubs, serving as the implementation unit corresponding to the shared token-kind declaration in GmcReserved.h.
